entities.name: Byzantine–Bulgarian War of 894–896
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: War fought between the bulgarian empire and the byzantine empire as a result of the decision of the byzantine emperor leo vi to move the bulgarian market from constantinople to thessaloniki Took place in Balkans. Date: 894 CE. Ended: 896 CE.
